company.name: Prodigy Finance
company.shortDescription: Prodigy Finance is a financing solutions for international students pursuing degrees that offer student loans for future earning potential.
company.description: Prodigy Finance is an online platform that offers community loans to international postgraduate students.  Prodigy Finance also provides a mobile app through which users can manage and access their loan information seamlessly. The platform specifically helps fund master's degree students in 18 countries, aiming to make education accessible to those who might not have other financing options.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $310,000,000, or 11.29% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $77,316,732 to $370,253,504, a 4.79x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
